mistakes.text: The crate placed under the open fruit.
mistakes.normalized: the crate placed under the open fruit
mistakes.feedback_sk: Debna sa sama neukladá, preto treba Passive s „was“: „was placed“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Bedna se sama neukládá, proto je potřeba Passive s „was“: „was placed“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The crate didn't place anything, so use Passive with “was”: “was placed”.

mistakes.text: The crate was place under the open fruit.
mistakes.normalized: the crate was place under the open fruit
mistakes.feedback_sk: V Passive patrí za „was“ past participle: „placed“, nie „place“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: V Passive patří za „was“ past participle: „placed“, ne „place“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Passive needs the past participle after “was”: “placed”, not “place”.

mistakes.text: The crate is placed under the open fruit.
mistakes.normalized: the crate is placed under the open fruit
mistakes.feedback_sk: Dej sa odohral v minulosti, preto „was placed“, nie „is placed“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Děj proběhl v minulosti, proto „was placed“, ne „is placed“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The action happened in the past, so use “was placed”, not “is placed”.

mistakes.text: Someone placed the crate under the open fruit.
mistakes.normalized: someone placed the crate under the open fruit
mistakes.feedback_sk: Kto debnu položil, nie je známe ani dôležité, preto sa hodí Passive: „was placed“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Kdo bednu položil, není známo ani důležité, proto se hodí Passive: „was placed“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Who placed it is unknown and unimportant, so the Passive fits: “was placed”.

mistakes.text: They placed the crate under the open fruit.
mistakes.normalized: they placed the crate under the open fruit
mistakes.feedback_sk: Kto debnu položil, nie je známe ani dôležité, preto sa hodí Passive: „was placed“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Kdo bednu položil, není známo ani důležité, proto se hodí Passive: „was placed“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Who placed it is unknown and unimportant, so the Passive fits: “was placed”.

mistakes.text: The crate was putted under the open fruit.
mistakes.normalized: the crate was putted under the open fruit
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Put“ je nepravidelné sloveso s rovnakým tvarom: „was put“, nie „was putted“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Put“ je nepravidelné sloveso se stejným tvarem: „was put“, ne „was putted“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Put” is irregular and doesn't change: “was put”, not “was putted”.
